capabilities: Reveal hidden dotfiles and extensionless files in the file explorer
Turn folders into Kanban boards with subfolders as columns
Edit code files with syntax highlighting, folding, and find and replace
Preview HTML, SVG, Mermaid, JSON, CSV, and diff files
Review Git diffs and chat with AI agents
disambiguation: Not only a code editor; it also adds Kanban boards, file management, Git review, and AI chat.
extras: Git, Ask AI, and adding external folders by symlink require desktop Obsidian; the plugin sends no analytics or telemetry, and pre-release builds can be installed through BRAT.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer and editor are built around notes, so hidden files, code files, and non-note formats are awkward to browse, edit, or preview.

relations.evidence: With the Iconize plugin, folder and note icons and :IconName: shortcodes show up on the board too.

requires.name: Coding agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot)

summary: Workspace plugin that adds hidden-file browsing, folder-based Kanban boards, a code editor with previews, Git diffs, and AI chat to Obsidian.
